description.en: KeepGo (operating since ~2010-2014 era, per its own footer) specializes in prepaid lifetime data bundles that never expire, refillable by GB, on 500+ networks across 170+ countries. Crypto payments are accepted for anonymity-minded buyers.
description.zh: KeepGo（页脚口径运营至 2026 年已逾十年）主打永不过期的终身流量包，可按 GB 续充，覆盖 170+ 国家、500+ 网络，并支持加密货币付款。

details.en:
KeepGo is one of the industry's longest-running players (footer copyright reads 2010-2026), and its direction is unlike travel day-packs: prepaid lifetime data bundles that never expire, refilled by the GB, on 500+ networks across 170+ countries at claimed wholesale rates. Crypto payments are accepted, and there are physical-SIM and IoT product lines alongside. The site claims 1.5M+ customers and a Trustpilot 4.6 (3,000+ reviews).

Flagship eSIMs: Corvus (Europe), Cygnus (USA + Canada) and Eridanus (Worldwide) lifetime profiles. They fit travelers who take one or two trips a year and do not want to re-research a new eSIM annually, or devices that need standing connectivity - car routers, tablets, GPS trackers.

Notes: the Shopify store could not be rendered this pass, so bundle prices were not directly verified (third-party directories quote from about $1 - unverified); per-GB cost typically runs above travel-pack rivals, so the value is "never expires", not unit price; coverage of 170+ countries is below the 200+ lists of the leaders.
details.zh:
KeepGo 是 eSIM 行业里的"长寿"玩家（页脚版权口径 2010-2026），主打方向与旅行日包完全不同：终身不过期的预付流量包，用完按 GB 续充，覆盖 170+ 国家、500+ 网络，官方称批发价接入；还接受加密货币付款，并有实体 SIM 与 IoT 卡产品线。自称 1.5M+ 用户、Trustpilot 4.6（3,000+ 评价）。

旗舰产品：Corvus（欧洲）、Cygnus（美国+加拿大）、Eridanus（全球）三款终身 eSIM。适合一年只出行一两次、不想每年重新研究买哪张卡的用户，也适合给车载路由、平板等长期设备供网。

注意：本轮 Shopify 店铺未能直接渲染，具体包价未直核（第三方目录口径约 $1 起，未核实）；其单位流量成本通常高于旅行日包品牌，性价比来自"不过期"而非单价；覆盖 170+ 国小于头部品牌的 200+ 名单。
